name: Believer’s Sanction
body:
You have become a leader in your divine order.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 16, Believer’s Boon, Believer’s Order, character level 15th, alignment must be within one step of your deity’s.

Benefit(s): You gain the higher-level domain power of your chosen domain. Treat your character level as your cleric level for all your cleric domain powers granted by this feat and Believer’s Order.
